scope: Public Trustified supplement test listings, individual report pages and retests, reviewed alongside current retail data. Results describe reported samples; current retail batches are not verified. Foods, bars and mass gainers outside this catalog are recorded as scope exclusions.

methodology.coverage: All 264 pass/fail, 89 retest, 19 gold-certified and 6 NMR report URLs in the public sitemaps, the comprehensive pass/fail index, and every visible supplement/category index were retrieved. Additional linked report URLs were attempted.
methodology.statusPolicy: Current exact-batch comprehensive index status is preferred, then matching category listing, then text report status. Badge, listing field and text report statuses are stored separately. Active alone is not converted to passed. Expired describes the source listing, not inferred product shelf-life.
methodology.datePolicy: Only unambiguous public publication dates are normalized. Ambiguous numeric dates remain text with null ISO date. Date Certified is retained separately and is not renamed publication date.
methodology.scope: Current supplement lineup plus multivitamin source records. Foods, protein bars, mass gainers and shilajit are excluded explicitly. No safety or batch claims are extended to other lots or entire brands.
limitations: Public indexes occasionally link a report URL reused for a newer batch; historical rows are retained separately without attaching the newer batch lab images.
Some report/certification pages expose image-only or empty text headers; matching public index facts are retained and unavailable values remain empty.
The public Wix protein category contains 100 visible entries; the comprehensive pass/fail index and report sitemap were used to avoid treating that category limit as complete coverage.
Report-gallery image links are recorded as published; their laboratory measurements are not transcribed or independently re-tested.
Some category-index links return HTTP 404; their index observations remain recorded and are identified explicitly.
